coalesce(sc.year, ap.year, ar.year, q.year, #{year}) year, sc.score_line scoreLine, sc.single_politics singlePolitics, sc.single_english singleEnglish, sc.single_math singleMath, sourceName, coalesce(ar_ds.url, sc_ds.url, ap_ds.url) sourceUrl from program p join college c on c.id = p.college_id join school s on s.id = c.school_id left join ( select ps.program_id, group_concat(concat(sub.code, ' ', sub.name) order by ps.subject_order separator ' / ') examSubjects from program_subject ps left join subject sub on sub.id = ps.subject_id group by ps.program_id ) subj on subj.program_id = p.id left join admission_score sc on sc.program_id = p.id and sc.year = #{year} left join admission_plan ap on ap.program_id = p.id and ap.year = #{year} left join admission_result ar on ar.program_id = p.id and ar.year = #{year} left join program_year_data_quality q on q.program_id = p.id and q.year = #{year} left join data_source sc_ds on sc_ds.id = sc.source_id left join data_source ap_ds on ap_ds.id = ap.source_id left join data_source ar_ds on ar_ds.id = ar.source_id where p.status = 'active' and s.status = 'active' and ( sc.program_id is not null or ap.program_id is not null or ar.program_id is not null or q.program_id is not null ) order by s.name, c.name, p.program_code, p.program_name limit #{limit}

hasConflict, q.missing_fields missingFields, coalesce(ar_ds.source_owner, sc_ds.source_owner, ap_ds.source_owner, '数据库') sourceOwner, coalesce(ar_ds.title, sc_ds.title, ap_ds.title, concat(s.name, ' ', y.year, ' ', p.program_name, ' 数据')) sourceName, coalesce(ar_ds.url, sc_ds.url, ap_ds.url) sourceUrl from program p join college c on c.id = p.college_id join school s on s.id = c.school_id join ( select program_id, year from admission_score where year between #{startYear} and #{endYear} union select program_id, year from admission_plan where year between #{startYear} and #{endYear} union select program_id, year from admission_result where year between #{startYear} and #{endYear} union select program_id, year from program_year_data_quality where year between #{startYear} and #{endYear} ) y on y.program_id = p.id left join ( select ps.program_id, group_concat(concat(sub.code, ' ', sub.name) order by ps.subject_order separator ' / ') examSubjects from program_subject ps left join ap.program_id = p.id and ap.year = y.year left join admission_result ar on ar.program_id = p.id and ar.year = y.year left join program_year_data_quality q on q.program_id = p.id and q.year = y.year left join data_source sc_ds on sc_ds.id = sc.source_id left join data_source ap_ds on ap_ds.id = ap.source_id left join data_source ar_ds on ar_ds.id = ar.source_id where p.status = 'active' and s.status = 'active' order by s.name, c.name, p.program_code, p.program_name, y.year
